round1_resolution.evidence: Now 'Plus haut : défiler pour charger' — 32 codepoints against the English 41 (was 70), U+202F before the colon verified in the bytes. Statement and gesture both survive.

Now 'Plan'; jobs stays 'Tâches' (glossary job = tâche) and the composer chips read 'Ouvrir le plan…' vs 'Ouvrir les tâches…', so the pane's two collections are named differently at every site that labels them.

'… ou de souscrire à Radient Pass dans la' + link 'page des paramètres' + 'pour accéder à des modèles d’IA sans limite de débit, à bas prix.' — one grammatical sentence, 'souscrire à' is the settled verb for taking a plan.
'Chargement échoué' — 17 codepoints (was 21), same failure meaning, still distinct from the transport arm's 'Non chargé' and the unproven arm's 'Historique non chargé'.

Now 'Consigne déléguée'. Checked the render site rather than the sidecar: the key is used once, at run-child-reader.tsx:386 inside BriefBlock, whose own documentation calls it 'the child's authored instruction'. The en context note ('tools/capabilities a subagent was delegated with') describes something that component does not render, so the note is stale, not the translation.
'Tronqué à la transmission. Le runtime n’enregistre que les 2 000 premiers caractères d’une erreur.' — 'au transport' gone, the 2 000 grouping kept.
'Annuler le réveil prévu {due}' — preposition-free, so it holds both the clock-only and the date-bearing shape formatWakeDue emits off-day.

'{prefix}Envoi suspendu tant que le sort de cette réponse est inconnu — elle a peut-être été transmise, donc plus rien ne peut être envoyé · Échap dans la carte la masque' — the held thing is named, and 'la' agrees with 'cette réponse'. All three claims (held, maybe delivered, Escape in the card) survive.

notes.observation: The new key carries one/many/other and renders 0 '0 tâche masquée', 1 '1 tâche masquée', 2 '2 tâches masquées', 5 '5 tâches masquées', 1000 '1000 tâches masquées', 1000000 '1000000 de tâches masquées'. ::group-off is kept in all three arms, as the en sidecar requires, so 1000 does not become '1 000' with a folded-row count. Naming the unit ('tâche') where English elides it is an addition of clarity, not of fact: the sidecar defines the count as hidden to-do items.

The en context sidecar still describes this label as naming the tools/capabilities a subagent was delegated with, while its only consumer (run-child-reader.tsx:386, BriefBlock) renders the authored brief. Worth a sidecar correction in a later pass; the fr value matches what is displayed.
